description: Boolean on closed objects, by id (elements or other objects): union (merge), subtract (the first minus the others, which are removed), trim (the same, the others kept) intersect (only the overlap), shell (one solid of their outside, everything inside gone; one id of a group merges its overlapping parts) or split (two ids: cut into three where they overlap, returned as pieces). The first id is kept and becomes a plain mesh (it loses parametric data, so walls, slabs, roofs, stairs and columns can only cut, not be cut). A door or window used to cut cuts its rough opening and stays, e.g. to open an imported wall. Objects that aren't closed solids are refused. Returns the result's id.

ids.description: The first is kept; two or more except shell (one is fine)
